question: In July 2023, who has been awarded the British Prime Minister's Points of Light award for volunteering several sustainability initiatives, including raising funds for children, since the age of three?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Moksha Roy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Moksha Roy is a young environmental activist who has been volunteering in various sustainability initiatives since the age of three.
 
• She has been awarded the British Prime Minister's Points of Light award for her exceptional voluntary service and dedication to sustainability.
 
• Among her initiatives, she has raised funds for children and actively participated in numerous environmental campaigns.
 
• Her efforts have been recognized internationally, highlighting the impact of youth in driving positive environmental change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Points of Light Award:**

 
 
• The Points of Light award was established by former US President George H.W. Bush in 1990 to recognize outstanding volunteer service.
 
• It is awarded to individuals who make a significant difference in their communities through voluntary efforts.
 
• The British Prime Minister's Points of Light award follows a similar model to honor volunteers in the UK and abroad.
 
• The award showcases the powerful impact that individuals can make through dedication and volunteerism.
 
 
 
• **Sustainability Initiatives:**
 
 
• Sustainability initiatives refer to actions and projects aimed at promoting environmental conservation and reducing ecological footprints.
 
• These initiatives often include activities like recycling, tree planting, energy conservation, and advocating for sustainable practices.
 
• Sustainability is crucial for ensuring that natural resources are available for future generations.
 
• Youth engagement in sustainability initiatives is vital as it fosters a sense of responsibility and innovation in addressing environmental challenges.
 
 
 
• **Volunteering:**
 
 
• Volunteering involves offering time and services to benefit others without financial gain.
 
• It plays a critical role in community building, social cohesion, and addressing societal needs.
 
• Volunteers can work in various sectors, including education, health, environment, and social services.
 
• Recognition awards like the Points of Light highlight the importance and impact of volunteer work in society.
